result.reason: The operative language appropriately limits renewals to 12 months (or less) and reduces the non-renewal deadline to 30 days. However, it includes neither the preferred 60-day Vendor reminder nor any cap on renewal price increases. Because the fallback also requires price increases to be capped at 5%, the clause does not fully reach either playbook position. The edits made are otherwise limited, preserve the original bilateral non-renewal right, and are professionally drafted.
